Route A artifact set should not proceed to export preparation without taxonomy audit
supersedes: public export preparation without structured limitation audit

public_gates: M2511 must audit the M2510 summary and failure_taxonomy.csv
M2511 must verify taxonomy rows include required fields source references severity known limitation route implication and forbidden interpretation
M2511 must verify all referenced source artifacts exist
M2511 must verify taxonomy preserves actor/action contract 72/3 and no hidden/oracle input boundary
M2511 must verify summary flags keep environment rollout simulation training ranking winner success-rate performance validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU and self-ID claims false
M2511 must not run external high-fidelity simulation environment rollout training replay PPO rank select a winner promote a checkpoint compute success rate or make verdict claims

do not import external high-fidelity simulation packages
do not run external high-fidelity simulation
do not change the deployed action contract
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not compute success rate or controller-family verdict metrics
do not claim high-fidelity validation readiness
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim driver performance from taxonomy rows

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the M2510 known failure taxonomy before export or route escalation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: engineering-controller known failure taxonomy result audit only; no environment rollout, external simulation, measured validation, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate verdict, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, driver-performance, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if taxonomy source references are missing
stop if taxonomy rows are incomplete
stop if taxonomy rows are interpreted as behavior-quality or driver-performance verdicts
stop if actor/action contract was changed
fallback_plan: route to taxonomy repair if rows or source references are invalid
route to branch synthesis or export preparation if audit accepts the taxonomy
stop for user review if taxonomy cannot avoid performance interpretations
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2510 generated a structured known failure taxonomy

training_stage.stage_objective: engineering-controller known failure taxonomy result audit
admission_evidence: Route A in docs/post-m2470-route-plan.md lists known failure taxonomy
blocked_shortcuts: no external simulator installation or import
allowed_updates: M2511 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one bounded follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: taxonomy source references and false claim flags are accepted or rejected explicitly
bounded follow-up route is registered if audit passes

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2511 audits known failure taxonomy and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2511; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit rejects the taxonomy, route to bounded repair rather than weakening self-ID or validation gates.
allowed_claims: engineering-controller known failure taxonomy result audit
no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, driver-performance verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits the structured known limitation artifact before export or route escalation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: does not decide paper verdict but protects known limitation interpretation
must_synthesize_if: another taxonomy artifact is proposed after audit
taxonomy rows are mistaken for driver performance
taxonomy route needs multiple repairs without valid source references

hypothesis: A bounded result audit can accept or reject the M2510 known failure taxonomy without turning limitations into performance or validation claims.
success_criteria: audit verifies M2510 summary status_pass true and result_class pass
audit verifies failure_taxonomy.csv has required fields and at least 8 rows
audit verifies all taxonomy source references exist
audit verifies false flags for environment rollout simulation training ranking winner success-rate performance validation and paper claims
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution environment rollout training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2511 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2511 changes actor input or action contract
M2511 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2511 steps an environment or runs policy rollout
M2511 treats taxonomy rows as driver performance
M2511 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2511 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2511 passes if it audits the known failure taxonomy and confirms schema, source references, contract boundary, and false claim flags without external simulation, environment rollout, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate, or verdict claims.
